The Pillars of Creating No.1s at Chandigarh University
Behind every No.1 is a strong foundation. Here is what ours is made of.
Prestigious Rankings & Accreditations
Ranked India’s No. 1 Private University for three consecutive years in the QS Asia University Rankings.
Industry-driven Learning
Industry-driven learning and career-ready training from Day 1, with hands-on experience and top-tier mentorship from 980+ industry leaders.
Best Career Opportunities
Best placements with the world’s leading companies, alongside diverse career pathways in entrepreneurship, defence, judiciary, and sports.
Research-Intensive Environment
A robust research ecosystem with state-of-the-art laboratories, government and industry-funded projects, and global research collaborations to drive scientific discovery.
Merit-Based Scholarships up to 100 Percent
Scholarships that ease financial barriers and help deserving students access quality education and pursue their dreams.
Multicultural Community and Global Exposure
A vibrant multicultural community with students from 68 countries, offering diverse perspectives and rich global exposure.
A Legacy of Sporting Glory and Cultural Pride
A dynamic sports and cultural ecosystem that nurtures athletic talent, celebrates artistic expressions, and encourages holistic development.
